limitations.note: The rewrite registers valid_b but incorrectly gates it with valid_a, so it stays low during a stall at count 5 instead of reflecting the count sampled at the clock edge.
Tying ready_a high changes the original reset behavior and lets the module accept a bit on the first clock after reset, when the original design only raises ready_a.
The test exercised a stall at count 5 but expected valid_b to stay low, so it confirmed the rewrite's assumption rather than catching the mismatch.
